incumbent.design: independent paper books combined only at capital/risk layer
incumbent.note: fixed fractions were promoted to generate clean forward attribution; economic superiority of the allocation itself was not asserted

fresh_live_smoke.interpretation: latest exact-SHA public smoke remains execution-cost negative and provides no realized sleeve-level OOS evidence

latest_alpha_factory_before_fresh_smoke.interpretation: the temporary maker-positive B2 snapshot did not persist into the next fresh exact-SHA live smoke, so it is not promotable evidence

dedicated_research_coordination.alpha_factory_boundary: do not duplicate HF/LF signal research; challenge only cross-sleeve capital allocation and common OOS utility

challenger.hypothesis: after enough sleeve-level forward OOS evidence exists, allocating only incremental capital to sleeves with positive conservative net utility after 1x/1.5x/2x execution-cost stress will outperform the fixed V5 fractions on common future windows while preserving a small exploration budget
challenger.important: the current shadow proposal is not a recommendation to change the live paper data-collection allocation; it is the fail-closed output of the promotion allocator when no sleeve has passed the existing OOS gates

chronological_oos_contract.training: only windows strictly before each test window
chronological_oos_contract.incumbent_ablation: fixed V5 capital fractions on the identical future strategy returns
chronological_oos_contract.challenger_ablation: evidence-weighted fractions computed from prior windows only
chronological_oos_contract.cost_assumption: source strategy returns must already include spread, fees, slippage, queue/fill realism, latency and adverse selection where applicable
promotion_requires: at least two strictly future test folds
positive incremental net return versus fixed V5 allocation
positive incremental return at 1.5x execution costs
positive incremental return at 2.0x execution costs
no bypass of existing per-sleeve OOS/tiny-pilot gates
max strategy fraction no greater than 30%
global drawdown and gross-risk limits unchanged

rollback_criteria: reject the challenger if common-window incremental net return is nonpositive
reject if either 1.5x or 2.0x cost-stressed incremental return is nonpositive
reject if performance depends on a sleeve that has not passed the existing OOS gate
reject if results require look-ahead, cross-window leakage or post-decision HF features
keep current V5 fixed allocation and reserve as the live paper data-collection baseline until a future approved integration passes all gates
